decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. The charge TXN-008082 for 47.77 EUR at Kestrel Athletic Club is on card CRD-000077. It was made on 2026-08-27 and posted on 2026-08-28. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 59 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's cancellation confirmation DOC-000063 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-28. That is one day after the charge was made. The charge was made before the cancellation took effect, so it belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge the dispute is declined.
